title: Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and recently raised up to $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B.

We analyze billions of alternative data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights on ridesharing, e-commerce marketplaces, payments, and more. Our on-demand insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on.

For three years and counting, we have been recognized as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces . We are a fast-growing technology company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners. Our offices are located in NYC, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore. We cultivate a people-centric culture focused on mastery, ownership, and transparency.


Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • You’ll be working with many strategic leaders within the company.
  • The ETL Engineering team is growing rapidly.
  • You’ll be challenged with a lot of big data problems.


About The Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our dynamic ETL Engineering team. The ideal candidate possesses 4+ years of software engineering experience and/or data engineering experience. An excellent candidate should have a solid understanding of Spark, SQL, and data pipeline experience. This individual will play a crucial role in supporting our strategic pipelines and optimize for reliability, efficiency, and performance.

Additionally, ETL Engineering serves as the gold standard for all other YipitData analyst teams, building and maintaining the core pipelines that power our products. This high-impact, high-visibility team is instrumental to the success of our rapidly growing business. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast paced strategic team and help solve some of our biggest data challenges.


We expect US East Coast work hours:

  • Candidates should be available and willing to work during East Coast business hours (approximately 10/11am – 6/7pm EST).


As Our Data Engineer You Will:

  • Build end-to-end data pipelines.
  • Help with setting best practices for our data modeling and pipeline builds.
  • Create documentation, architecture diagrams, and other training materials for analysts.
  • Become an expert at solving complex data pipeline issues using Pyspark and SQL.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to incorporate business logic into our central pipelines.
  • Deeply learn Databricks, Airflow, and other ETL toolings.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline.
  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, Data Analyst, or in other technical function.
  • You are excited about solving data challenges and learning new skills.
  • You have some understanding of working with data or building data pipelines.
  • You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets using PySpark or Pandas.
  • You understand business needs and the rationale behind data transformations to ensure alignment with organizational goals and data strategy.
  • You are eager to constantly learn new technologies.
  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working collaboratively with stakeholders.
  • You have exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Nice to have: Experience with Airflow, dbt, or equivalent.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Site Reliability Engineer - (SRE / DevOps) – Azure
description:

  • Desenvolver, manter e escalar infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform em ambientes multi-região.
  • Gerenciar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e GitHub Actions , garantindo entregas rápidas e seguras.
  • Atuar no ciclo de incidentes em produção , incluindo triagem, análise de causa raiz (Root Cause Analysis), documentação e implementação de correções preventivas.

  • Administrar e monitorar serviços críticos como Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Data Factory, App Services, API Management, Application Gateway e redes privadas (VNet, ExpressRoute) .
  • Gerenciar e integrar soluções de observabilidade com Datadog , criando dashboards personalizados, alertas e métricas para clusters e serviços em Azure.
  • Apoiar a gestão de dados em Databricks , garantindo integridade, performance e segurança dos pipelines de dados.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com Microsoft Azure (AKS, Azure Data Factory, App Services, API Management, Application Gateway, Networking).
  • Proficiência em Terraform para provisionamento e gestão de infraestrutura em nuvem.
  • Experiência prática com CI/CD usando Azure DevOps Pipelines e GitHub Actions .
  • Conhecimento avançado em observabilidade com Datadog (criação de dashboards, alertas, monitoramento de clusters).
  • Experiência com Databricks e processos de data engineering em nuvem.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ciclo de incidentes com foco em resolução rápida e prevenção de recorrência.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (leitura, escrita e comunicação oral) – necessário para colaboração com times globais.


Benefícios e Cultura

  • Ambiente colaborativo, inovador e com foco em crescimento profissional.
  • Flexibilidade de horários e trabalho remoto.
  • Programa de capacitação contínua (cursos, certificações, eventos).
  • Participação em projetos estratégicos com impacto real no negócio.
  • Integração com o Mantu Group , rede de empresas de tecnologia e consultoria com presença global.

title: AWS-Python Production Support Enginner
description:
AWS-Python Production Support Engineer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Full Remote

Experience: Seniority Level

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues across environments, including pipeline failures and data inconsistencies.
  • Maintain and evolve schema-driven YAML/JSON configurations for distribution and exhibition platforms.
  • Support operational workflows by updating internal Python automation scripts.
  • Perform database-level investigations to validate data integrity and confirm fixes.
  • Work through PR-based change management with clear documentation and regression verification.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery operations.
  • Apply observability and log analysis techniques to trace failures and extract actionable insights.
  • Ensure compliance with schema validation and maintain configuration hygiene.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.
  • Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.
  • Observability & log analysis: Tracing failures across pipeline stages, correlating identifiers, and extracting actionable signals from logs/metrics.
  • Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.
  • Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.
  • Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.
  • Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.
  • Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.


Optional Knowledge

  • Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.
  • Advanced mapping/config patterns (conditional/switch/lookup/padding; robust globals/locals usage).
  • CI/automation improvements (linting/formatting, pre-validation checks, regression harnesses).
  • Partner operations context (common rejection patterns, partner-specific exceptions, operational playbooks).
  • Communication in incident/PR contexts (concise updates, change summaries, and requirement translation).


Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.
  • Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil . Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be a part of -->


Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.


Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

title: Manager / Senior Manager, FP&A
description:

Build and maintain 3-statement financial models , with a strong understanding of how they flow together

Develop financial models from scratch, including ROI analysis and scenario modeling

Prepare monthly and quarterly financial review decks , clearly explaining business performance using financial storytelling and waterfall analyses

  • 5+ years of FP&A experience , ideally within a Fortune 500 environment
  • Experience in mid-sized companies is a strong plus
  • Strong understanding of 3-statement financial modeling
  • Advanced Excel skills (heavy modeling role; keyboard-driven workflows preferred)
  • Experience creating executive-level PowerPoint presentations with clear financial narratives (Experience with IBM Cognos / TM1 is a plus, Tableau experience is a plus, but Private Equity experience is highly preferred)
  • Create and maintain dashboards, clean and validate data, and build data models across multiple data sources. Support cross-database integrations and deliver actionable financial and business insights.


What We’re Looking For


  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, less structured environments
  • Independent and able to take ownership of projects from start to finish

Intellectually curious and proactive in asking the right questions

This role is critical to keeping our content engine moving: sourcing top-tier creators, managing relationships, anticipating roadblocks, negotiating UGC costs, and ensuring deliverables flow smoothly from concept to edit-ready.


You’ll be the point person between creators, Creative Strategists, and Operations , bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, takes initiative, and solves problems independently.


Key Responsibilities
  • Own the full creator lifecycle, from sourcing and vetting to delivery and payment


  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, ensuring clear expectations, timelines, and communication


  • Act as the operational hub for all creator-related projects, keeping internal tools (Notion, Slack, etc) accurate, up to date, and easy to understand at a glance


  • Proactively track progress across all concepts and creators, identifying risks, delays, or gaps before they escalate


  • Coordinate closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creators are fully aligned on briefs, constraints, and deliverables


  • Ensure seamless handoff of content to post-production, with well-organized assets and clear documentation


  • Handle reshoots, revisions, and edge cases with a solution-first mindset


  • Manage & negotiate creator payments and documentation in a timely and organized manner


What Success Looks Like
  • Anyone opening our tracking systems can instantly understand the status of every creator and deliverable


  • Creators feel supported, informed, and motivated to deliver high-quality content on time


  • Issues are flagged early, communicated clearly, and resolved efficiently


  • Content moves forward without bottlenecks, confusion, or last-minute fire drills


Required Qualities
  • Highly organized : able to manage multiple creators, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously


  • Proactive and accountable : you don’t wait to be asked—you move things forward


  • Problem-solver : able to find creative solutions independently before escalating


  • Strong communicator : clear, concise, and professional across Slack, email, and documentation


  • Detail-oriented but execution-focused : you balance precision with speed


Experience & Background
  • Proven experience working with creators, talent, or influencers (UGC content preferred)


  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-output environment


  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with creative, operations, and production teams



Why This Role Matters

This role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.



Compensation & Perks:

Base Salary from $2,000-$3,250 USD per month

Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)

Fully Remote

Time Zone: EST

title: Sr. Product Analyst
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our flag ship product is a Chromium browser, that provides a powerful and secure way to search the web; and our growing ecosystem includes a portfolio of innovative mobile products. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Analyst to join our team and help drive data-informed decisions to help grow and optimize our browser products. This individual will play a critical role in analyzing user behavior, evaluating feature performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high quality data insights. This role is best suited for a confident self-starter and requires a blend of creative vision, technical know-how, strong communication / presentation skills, and exceptional organizational skills.


Key Responsibilities


Data Analysis, Insights, & Skills

  • Extract, clean, and analyze data using SQL to understand product performance, user behavior, and business trends
  • Proficient at using / analyzing excel, dashboards, reports, and KPIs to monitor product health/performance
  • Understands what constitutes “accuracy” for various data sets and can run checks to verify the accuracy of a data set
  • Automatically goes the “extra step” on assigned tasks.
  • Able to provide actionable recommendations to product managers and leadership teams
  • Capable of providing clear and concise write-ups for complex analysis
  • Capable of performing tasks with speed and efficiency


Personality Traits

  • People excel in this position that are self – starters, confident, and competitive
  • They are capable of self-management and independent decision making
  • They have strong time/priority management skills
  • They are team players and can see problems from multiple points of view.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA’s, User Acquisition, and Design teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions
  • Partner with stakeholders to identify key metrics and measure the success of product initiatives
  • Understands the differences between team level updates and executive level updates


Experimentation & Optimization

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation frameworks to validate hypotheses and inform product decisions
  • Analyze experiment results and recommend next steps for product improvements


Agile/Scrum Processes

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and daily stand-ups to align analytics work with product development priorities
  • Deliver insights in iterative cycles that align with Agile methodologies


Who You Are


  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or similar)
  • 5+ years of firsthand experience in management/analysis of data within a Structured Query Language (SQL) database (Preferred: Microsoft SQL Server, Amazon Redshift) with proven SQL and query writing skills
  • Experience collecting and analyzing data and reporting on the results using Excel or a statistical software package
  • Demonstrated ability to extract and assimilate data from multiple sources and communicate analysis in a concise, easy-to-understand, and actionable format
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and working in iterative development cycles
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled \"Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  • Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  • Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

We’re looking for a Training & Development leader who drives real impact. In this role, you’ll design and deliver learning programs that help employees excel in their roles, accelerate their careers, and develop the next generation of strong leaders. If you’re passionate about learning that transforms performance and strengthens organizational capability, this is the role for you.


Responsibilities


  • Own the full lifecycle of training and development programs, from needs assessment through delivery, to strengthen workforce capability, performance, and productivity.
  • Assess skill gaps and business needs to design targeted learning programs that overcome performance challenges and boost workforce effectiveness.
  • Develop and scale programs that accelerate internal mobility, strengthen functional talent pipelines, and build leadership readiness.
  • Partner with business leaders to ensure learning initiatives align with department goals, driving both capability building and measurable business impact.
  • Create and maintain engaging training content for e-learning, virtual, and live sessions, with clear learning objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Implement post-training evaluations and reinforcement micro-learning to ensure knowledge retention and consistent on-the-job application.
  • Track and continuously improve key metrics, including time-to-perform, new hire ramp-up, training completion and application rates, and talent readiness for future roles.


Requirements :


  • 8+ years of experience in Training, Learning & Development, or Organizational Development.
  • Deep expertise in instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies; relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Proven experience with e-learning authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Rise) and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Brightspace.
  • Demonstrated success in designing, delivering, and scaling learning programs that drive measurable skill development and business impact.
  • Ability to understand complex or technical information and translate it into clear, engaging, and effective training content.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Highly organized, results-oriented, and able to work independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Make a direct impact by designing and delivering learning programs that develop global talent, accelerate careers, and drive organizational success.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Network Engineer Commissioning Specialist (BSC/RNC), OSS and Sites
description:
We are looking for a Wireless Specialist with solid experience in mobile networks, responsible for commissioning, integration, and validation of Controllers (BSC/RNC), as well as operation and management of OSS platforms and support for field activities related to telecommunications sites.

This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client’s technical requirements.


Responsibilities:

  • (Must-have). Perform commissioning, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of 2G/3G/4G/5G, Controllers (BSC/RNC) and OSS.
  • Execute configuration, expansion, and technical audit activities on OSS platforms.
  • Support and accompany field activities related to the activation of new sites, swaps, migrations, and network expansions.
  • Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.
  • Monitor network KPIs and alarms, identifying and proactively resolving faults.
  • Prepare technical reports, action plans, and network documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with planning, O&M, and optimization teams to ensure network performance and stability.
  • Provide technical support during maintenance windows and critical activation processes including SWAPs.



Technical Requirements:

  • Proven experience with BSC and/or RNC Controllers (any vendor: ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei).
  • Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
  • Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2G/3G/4G/5G networks.
  • Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
  • Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
  • Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
  • Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
  • Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.


Desired Profile:

  • Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Clear and objective communication with clients and internal teams.
  • Ability to work under pressure and during critical maintenance windows.
  • Proactive and collaborative attitude.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
  • Certifications or training related to mobile networks will be considered an advantage.

Home Alliance Venture Studio is building one of the fastest-growing ecosystems in the U.S.​ Our offer ranges from $1,000 → $100,000+ high-ticket programs , with a constant flow of highly qualified inbound leads​: 


  • Digital products ($1,000–$10,000)
  • Consulting & mentorship ($10,000–$40,000)
  • Franchise packages ($20,000–$100,000+)
  • Online academies & virtual education
  • SaaS subscriptions
  • AI products (AllianceVoice.ai, etc.)


Each product vertical will have 3–5 dedicated closers , and we are scaling aggressively.


About the role:


As a Remote Closer, you will handle qualified inbound leads generated through our marketing funnels. Your job is to consult prospects, understand their goals, and enroll them into the program or product that best fits their needs. This is NOT cold calling.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a performance-driven environment, communicates with clarity and empathy, and excels at closing digital product sales via Zoom or phone.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct scheduled sales calls (Zoom or phone) with warm, pre-qualified leads.
  • Follow a proven sales framework while incorporating your own style.
  • Ask powerful questions to understand client goals, challenges, and fit.
  • Present the offer clearly and handle objections professionally.
  • Maintain accurate call notes and pipeline updates in the CRM.
  • Collaborate with the sales team for continuous improvement.
  • Meet or exceed weekly and monthly closing targets.
  • Uphold brand values and represent our company with integrity.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 1–2 years of closing experience, preferably in digital products (courses, coaching, SaaS, education, consulting).
  • ​Strong communication and emotional intelligence.
  • Confidence in leading consultative sales conversations.
  • Reliable internet connection and quiet workspace.
  • High ownership mindset and ability to work independently.
  • Coachable, growth-oriented, and comfortable receiving feedback.
  • Familiarity with CRMs (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Close, or similar).


Preferred (Bonus)

  • Experience in high-ticket closing ($1k–$15k offers).
  • Understanding of online marketing funnels.
  • Background in personal development, business coaching, or tech.


Compensation

  • Commission-based  (industry-leading payouts)
  • OTE:

* $8,000–$20,000/month

* Top performers: $30,000–$50,000+/month

  • Upside based on productivity — no ceiling
  • Quick promotion for consistent closers
  • Opportunity for promotion to Senior Closer or Sales Lead.


What We Offer

  • Inbound, qualified leads (no cold calling).
  • A proven, in-demand digital product suite.
  • Weekly training, call reviews, and performance coaching.
  • Supportive, high-performance remote sales culture.
  • Flexible hours (within US time zones).​

title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience
description:
Title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner, we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting‑edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.

We are looking for a talented and motivated UX/UI Designer to join our UX team. If you are proactive, organized, and passionate about creating exceptional user experiences, we want to meet you!


Responsibilities

• UX Research: Conduct research using techniques such as desk research, user and stakeholder interviews, benchmarking, surveys, persona creation, user journeys, empathy maps, user flows, sitemaps, and more.

• Perform tests such as user testing, shadowing, field research, tree testing, and A/B testing to generate valuable insights during project discovery.

• UI Design: Develop low-, medium-, and high-fidelity prototypes, creating visually appealing and functional interfaces aligned with user and project needs.


Requirements

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in UX and UI projects.

• Intermediate English for conversation is required.

• Spanish is considered a plus.


Skills

• Strong experience in UX Research and UI Design.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively, with excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Excellent communication skills to present ideas and collaborate with different stakeholders.

• Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Miro, Maze, and others.

• Strategic thinking, context awareness, and ability to adapt solutions to project needs.


OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!



O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines ETL com Informatica.
  • Realizar análise de dados para apoiar modelagem e integrações.
  • Criar e otimizar consultas Oracle SQL para performance.
  • Documentar processos e repassar conhecimento para o time.



O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Conhecimento em Informatica e SQL
  • Experiência com SQL em Oracle
  • Experiência em iImplementar workflows ETL no Informatica



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Coordenador Tributário
description:
Job Description

  • Missão do Cargo:

Responsável por coordenar e garantir o cumprimento das obrigações principais e acessórias relacionadas aos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI e ISS), assegurando a conformidade tributária da empresa de forma tempestiva e eficiente. Atua como referência técnica e estratégica na área fiscal, promovendo alinhamento entre as operações e a legislação vigente.


  • Principais responsabilidades:


Técnicas:

  • Coordenar as atividades da área fiscal/tributária, com foco nos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI e ISS).
  • Garantir a correta apuração dos tributos e escrituração fiscal de notas fiscais de entradas (matéria-prima, consumo e serviços) dentro do período de competência.
  • Monitorar créditos e débitos registrados nos livros fiscais, assegurando controle e revisão para suportar novas operações de negócio.
  • Realizar conciliações das contas patrimoniais relacionadas aos impostos indiretos, identificando e explicando variações entre balancetes e apurações.
  • Realizar pesquisas legislativas e jurisprudenciais com o time consultivo, visando identificar riscos e oportunidades de planejamento tributário.
  • Acompanhar prazos de vencimento e renovação de Regimes Especiais, Certidões Negativas e DEC Municipal.
  • Atender auditorias internas e externas, bem como fiscalizações dos órgãos federais, estaduais e municipais, fornecendo informações e documentos necessários.
  • Alinhar fluxos de processos com áreas internas para garantir o correto envio e registro de documentos fiscais.
  • Participar de projetos sistêmicos (ex.: S4, KSRM, Move2, Transportation), identificando gaps e propondo melhorias para o correto registro fiscal.


Pessoas:

  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares aproximadamente 12 profissionais;
  • Estabelecer metas individuais e coletivas, conduzir reuniões de alinhamento e feedback técnico/comportamental;
  • Promover o engajamento da equipe para garantir entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Treinar áreas internas sobre novos procedimentos fiscais, garantindo conformidade na emissão de documentos por fornecedores e prestadores de serviços.

Component-based architectures;

  • 3+ years of Salesforce Admin or Developer experience

  • Comfortable maintaining and improving telephony integrations (RingCentral preferred)

  • Detail-oriented with clean documentation and high accuracy
  • Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet
  • Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with merchant cash advance companies
  • Background in CRM architecture or workflow optimization

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer


We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.


You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.


This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer

This role is open to Brazil-based professionals with strong experience in Pricing/Optimization or Computer Vision , who are passionate about building and deploying production-grade ML systems that drive real business impact.

description:
About the Role

We’re hiring high-performing B2B SaaS Account Executives based in LATAM who want full ownership of their number and unlimited earning potential.

This is a role for builders, not order-takers. You’ll own the entire sales cycle, work directly with US-based customers, and be rewarded on performance. If you believe sales is the fastest path to growth, autonomy, and income, this role is for you.


About Lilo

Lilo is rebuilding procurement for Commercial Real Estate using AI.

Hotels and CRE operators still manage procurement with emails, calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. Lilo replaces that chaos with a single AI-powered platform that automates purchasing, vendor management, invoice processing, and price optimization.

We work with major hotel management companies and staple hotel brands in the US, and we’re in an explosive growth path. Top performers have outsized impact and ownership.


What You’ll Do

  • Own the entire outbound sales motion : prospecting, discovery, demo, close with US-based customers
  • Represent Lilo at industry events and network your way to high profile decision makers
  • Build and manage a pipeline of C-level operators, hotel owners, and decision-makers
  • Navigate consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Work closely with onboarding and product to ensure long-term customer success


What We’re Looking For

  • Excellent written and spoken English (C2 level)
  • Up to 5 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales (closing role, not SDR-only)
  • Proven track record owning full sales cycles
  • Strong outbound prospecting skills (email, LinkedIn, calls)
  • Experience selling to US-based customers
  • Comfortable working remotely with high independence
  • Competitive, performance-driven mindset


Compensation & Upside

  • Base salary: US$2,500/Mo.
  • On Target Commission: $2,500+/Mo. (50/50 split)
  • Total OTE: $5,000+/Mo.
  • Uncapped commissions + boosters
  • ESOP package with high potential upside

The harder you grind, the more you make.


Who Should NOT Apply

This role is not for you if:

  • You are not confident selling in English to US customers
  • You want a passive, inbound-only sales role
  • You need heavy structure, scripts, or constant supervision
  • You’re uncomfortable picking up the phone, doing outbound outreach, and rejection
  • You’re looking for a slow-moving, corporate environment


Why Lilo?

  • Fully remote role with a fast-growing, US-based startup
  • USD compensation with uncapped upside
  • Direct exposure to high profile US-based customers
  • Fast-moving startup with real ownership and accountability
  • Early-stage opportunity with real revenue ownership and ESOP upside
  • Performance-first compensation with uncapped upside
  • Ambitious, low-ego, execution-focused team
  • Exposure to AI, SaaS, and hospitality at scale

title: Azure / Windows Architect
description:

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead Azure migrations: Conduct on‑prem/public cloud infra assessments using Azure Migrate and drive solutioning for large, complex Azure migrations.

  • Architect & document: Provide Azure target architecture (HLD/LLD), BoM pricing, licensing details, and clear TCO/ROI rationale.
  • Migrate & troubleshoot: Migrate on‑prem workloads to Azure; troubleshoot Azure/Windows issues across processor, networking, clusters, I/O, and memory.

  • Windows services expertise: Administer and troubleshoot Windows File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; perform upgrades, backups, and restorations.
  • Team leadership: Govern and technically guide infra teams (5+ members); provide 24×7 support and work in shifts.
  • Stakeholder collaboration: Work with internal/customer stakeholders and PMs across banking, healthcare, and insurance domains; ensure risks are mitigated and lessons captured post‑project.


Must have skills:

  • Experience: 13+ years in IT; 5+ years in Azure Infra, Azure Migrate, Azure Networking (IaaS/PaaS), DC/Cloud/Security/SIAM/Data/Storage.
  • Azure services: Azure Key Vault, Azure IAM, Landing Zone design, BoM/pricing/licensing, TCO/ROI.
  • Windows administration: File/Print, DNS, WINS, DHCP, clustering, DFS; server consolidation, upgrades, backup/restore.
  • Migration & troubleshooting: On‑prem to Azure via Azure Migrate; deep troubleshooting in Azure & Windows environments.
  • Leadership & support: Team governance (5+), stakeholder management, 24×7 support readiness, shift flexibility.


Good to have:

  • Certifications: AZ‑305 (Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions), AZ‑104 (Microsoft Azure Administrator).
  • Design exposure: DR/business continuity, identity/governance/monitoring solutions; solution presentations and customer communication.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Senior Scrum Master - Customer Data Ecosystem

Brazil

Contract-to-hire


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Facilitate daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives for the customer data ecosystem teams
  • Remove obstacles and impediments that hinder the team’s progress, ensuring smooth and efficient workflows.
  • Coach the team on Agile principles and practices, ensuring adherence to Scrum frameworks.
  • Collaborate with product owners to manage the product backlog and ensure clear communication of requirements.
  • Track team performance metrics, such as velocity and burndown, and work to improve productivity and efficiency.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the team, encouraging the adoption of Agile best practices.
  • Foster a collaborative environment where team members feel empowered to contribute and innovate.
  • Work with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all sprints consider data privacy and regulatory requirements.
  • Facilitate the integration of compliance requirements into the agile development process.
  • Lead efforts to align Scrum practices with the organization’s digital marketing strategy and goals.
  • Provide guidance on managing dependencies between teams and coordinating cross-team collaboration.
  • Stay current with industry trends in Agile methodologies, applying relevant advancements to improve team performance.
  • Ensure that the team’s work is aligned with business objectives, delivering value to the organization.
  • Provide training and mentoring to team members and other Scrum Masters within the organization.
  • Lead efforts to resolve conflicts and challenges within the team, ensuring a positive and productive work environment.
  • Drive Change Management through coaching the team and support them on the Transformation journey by establishing clear processes and challenging them on shifting mindset
  • Oversee the integration and use of Azure Dev Ops tools within project teams to optimize collaboration, code management, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Drive the adoption of Azure DevOps features among the team, ensuring they are leveraged to enhance project transparency and delivery efficiency
